verdict.rationale: Floot ships a first-party remote MCP server that exposes many platform operations programmatically: logs, database reads and writes, migrations, checkpoints and image generation. It also claims you can build and ship whole apps from an AI chat. Parity with the UI is not documented, though, and some flows still need the browser: API keys must be typed into Floot's secure web dialog, and checkpoints are reverted from the project's Checkpoint panel. No OpenAPI/REST spec was found. Missing for 10: documented full UI–API parity, a conventional REST API with an OpenAPI spec, a programmatic path for secret entry and other UI-only actions, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
